# ECO387C Macro I midterm prep (Fall 2026)

These are my study materials for the Macro I midterm at UT Austin. The
course text is the Azzimonti, Krusell, McKay and Mukoyama draft. The exam is
closed book, with no notes.

## What's here

- `exams/`: everything I built to prepare. `exams/README.md` has the topic
  map and the checklist.
  - `practice-packet.pdf` (32 pp.) works through the class material in order.
    Each part sets up the model, derives the results step by step, and then
    has worked problems (21 in total).
  - `mock-midterm.pdf` is a mock exam with 4 questions, each split into
    lettered parts, with space to write answers.
  - `mock-midterm-solutions.pdf` has the full worked solutions.
  - `mock-midterm-q1-writeup.pdf` is Question 1 written up in my problem-set
    format.
  - `cheat-sheet-print.pdf` is a two-sided memorization sheet.
  - `*-checks.py` / `*-checks.txt` check every number in the packet and the
    mock.
- `lectures/`: the handwritten lecture notes (PDF), each with a page-by-page
  Markdown transcription.
- `discussions/`: TA discussion handouts 1-6.

## Building

The LaTeX compiles with tectonic (12pt, offline cache). The check scripts
need Python with numpy and scipy.
